description:
Patch Brand DNA. Send only keys to change. Nested bags (offer,
product_map, icp) merge. Examples: {tagline, overview,
offer: {product_name, one_liner, features, who_its_for, primary_cta},
product_map: {offerings, how_we_work}, icp: {who_buys, pains}}.
Does not read or write Brand Memory.

fields.description: Brand DNA keys to change, e.g. {"tagline": "...", "offer": {"one_liner": "..."}}. Nested bags merge.

name: update_brand_dna
